headline: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Spencer's Retail Limited
sum: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition or acquisition triggering mechanism in Spencer's Retail Limited, a major Indian multi-format retail chain.
detail: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited has submitted a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the National Stock Exchange, triggering the public disclosure regime. The filing does not disclose the acquisition size, consideration, or timeline in the Bar & Bench snippet; however, Reg 31(4) is triggered upon acquisition of shares amounting to 5% or more of voting capital or upwards. Spencer's Retail is a listed multi-format retailer with operations across supermarkets, hypermarkets and specialty stores. The acquirer, Lebnitze Real Estates, is a private entity; its relationship to existing promoters or external investors requires cross-verification.
